description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for search filter parameters related to allowed pay grade currencies, extending a base search filter class and specifying default sorting fields.

classes.name: AllowedPayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for allowed pay grade currencies, with default sorting set to 'ct.id'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO and sets the default sort field to 'ct.id'.
